messages.content: My program uses OpenMP threads. Show a small batch script that runs ./my_program as one task with four CPU cores and sets its thread count from Slurm.

Request four CPU cores for the task and set OMP_NUM_THREADS from SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=hello
#SBATCH --time=00:10:00
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --output=%x-%j.out

export OMP_NUM_THREADS=$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK
./my_program
```
